metadata.case_name: WONG CHI HO JACKY v. POON YUK SHAN

plaintiff.occupation_after: employed as a mechanic in a garage (August 2002)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: could return to his pre-injury employment or as a mechanic (orthopaedic opinion)

source: When he was seen by a neurologist in July 2002, he was diagnosed to have suffered mild post-concussional syndrome, with no significant improvement expected.

injuries.description: fractured clavicle of the right shoulder
source: He also suffered injuries which included fractured clavicle of the right shoulder and soft tissue injury to the left knee.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the left knee
source: He also suffered injuries which included fractured clavicle of the right shoulder and soft tissue injury to the left knee.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

manifestations.description: lost consciousness momentarily after the accident
given sick leave for some 23.5 months
loss of earning capacity estimated at 1% (neurologist)
loss of earning capacity assessed at 6% (orthopaedic specialist)
Employees' Compensation (Ordinary Assessment) Board assessed loss of earning capacity at 7% on 27 September 2002, revised to 4% after review on 24 January 2003

treatments_received: Employees' Compensation proceedings (District Court) resulting in Consent Order dated 18 August 2003, employees' compensation agreed at $293,873.00 inclusive of interest, of which $230,844.30 had already been paid as advance payment

losses.description: Loss of earning capacity: neurologist estimated 1%; orthopaedic specialist assessed 6%; Board assessed 7% (27 September 2002) and revised to 4% (24 January 2003). Period of absence confirmed at 23.5 months.
